name: Sher Khan
label: SHER KHAN
look: a broad, stocky, serious security guard (chowkidar) in his forties with a thick black moustache, heavy eyebrows, a black beret with a gold badge, a khaki short-sleeved uniform shirt with pocket flaps and epaulettes, khaki trousers, a black belt, black boots, a silver whistle on a black cord, and a long wooden lathi stick
personality: Strict, proud of his uniform, takes his duty very seriously; secretly lazy on night shifts.
catchphrase: Meri duty pe parinda bhi par nahi maar sakta!
catchphrase_say: मेरी ड्यूटी पे परिंदा भी पर नहीं मार सकता!

mouth.note: Mouth sits just under the moustache. The acting sheet has no lathi stick (the turnaround does).
